summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the title escape formatter (ESC ]0; title BEL) and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a legacy branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking #2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run, installed, or committed, so mypy, Black, and pytest results are unverified; line lengths were checked by hand against 88 characters.
